modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Cayman Airways sets carry-on limits by type of service: international jet, domestic jet and domestic propeller.

personal_item.value: On jet services, one personal item up to 38 inches (14”L x 14”W x 10”H) and 15lbs, such as a briefcase, purse, small laptop or camera case.

carryon_weight.value: No weight limit is stated for the jet-service carry-on bag. On domestic propeller service the only carry-on allowed is one bag up to 38 inches (14”L x 14”W x 10”H) and 15lbs.

weight_economy.value: 1 cabin bag up to 11.5 kg (25 lbs) + 1 personal item

weight_business_first.value: 1 cabin bag up to 11.5 kg (25 lbs) + 1 personal item

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Each checked bag must not exceed 62 linear inches (157 cm) and 55 lbs; passengers can check up to 8 bags, with fees.

size_weight.value: Each checked bag up to 62 linear inches (157 cm) total length + width + height and not exceeding 55 lbs.

international_fees.value: International flights, tickets issued on/after Nov. 1, 2025: Economy Class pays USD 30 each for the 1st and 2nd bag if paid on the website or app via Manage My Booking (USD$35 via the call center, ticket office or at check-in), USD 75 for the 3rd bag; Business Class gets the first 3 bags free.

domestic_jet.value: Domestic jet service between Grand Cayman and Cayman Brac: Business Class 3 bags free, Economy Class 2 bags free. Additional bags: USD 30 up to 55 lbs, USD 60 for 56 – 70 lbs, USD 90 for 71 – 99 lbs.

domestic_propeller.value: Twin Otter or Saab flights to or from Cayman Brac or Little Cayman: 55 lbs. per person (combined weight of up to 2 pieces); excess US$0.50 per pound between Grand Cayman and Cayman Brac/Little Cayman, US$0.25 per pound between Cayman Brac and Little Cayman.

overweight_oversize.value: Overweight bags: US$50 per bag weighing 56lbs-70lbs (not exceeding 99lbs). Oversized bags (over 62 and up to 120 linear inches): US$75 per bag up to 55lbs.

piece_weight_economy.value: 2 pieces up to 25 kg (55 lbs) each included free on most routes

piece_weight_business.value: 3 pieces up to 25 kg (55 lbs) each included

piece_weight_first.value: 3 pieces up to 25 kg (55 lbs) each (Business Class is top cabin)

domestic_cutoff.value: 30 minutes before departure (Cayman Brac / Little Cayman)

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: These are standards published by the carrier for delays and cancellations. On codeshares or interline itineraries, the operating carrier is responsible.

care.value: Refreshments, meals, phone access, and hotel vouchers for overnight delays caused by airline control.

rebooking_refund.value: Choice of full refund or rebooking to destination free of charge for cancellations or delays >3 hours.

compensation.value: US DOT and CAACI passenger protection guidelines apply.

seat_selection_included.value: Included on Economy and Business Class; fee on Super Saver until check-in.

change_cancellation_policy.value: Super Saver non-refundable; Economy/Business allow low-fee changes or full refund.

modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose a seat by location and legroom, or accept a free seat assignment at check-in. Use your flight seat map because options vary with the aircraft.

seat_options.value: Standard Economy, Business Class leather recliners (B737 MAX 8).

reserved_or_random.value: Free advance seat selection for Economy and Business; fee or check-in assignment for Super Saver.

family_seating.value: Cayman Airways automatically seats children under 12 with an accompanying adult.
